pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and stellate dark-ochre regions with moderately soft pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patches are medium-sized with predominantly obtuse interior angles and rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, cream-colored inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological lattice. The network exhibits high pixel thickness relative to patch size, with distinct three-way and four-way junction nodes across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck, appearing as a dense, uniform brush-like texture with a consistent height profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Tail is positioned dorsally, arched over the sacral region with the terminal black-haired tuft resting against the posterior flank.
